item.title: [BUG] Copilot Chat causes main code process to spike memory 200%+ during input and response

labels.name: info-needed
labels.description: Issue requires more information from poster

item.body:
Type: Bug **Bug Report: Excessive Memory Usage in VS Code Main Process During Copilot Chat Usage** ## Summary The VS Code main process (`code`) experiences memory spikes of over 200% when using GitHub Copilot Chat, specifically during typing and processing operations. ## Environment - **Device**: MacBook Air M2, 16GB RAM - **OS**: macOS [your version] - **VS Code Version**: [run `Cmd+Shift+P` → "Help: About" to get exact version] - **GitHub Copilot Version**: [latest with auto-update enabled] - **GitHub Copilot Chat Version**: [latest with auto-update enabled] ## Installed Extensions - Container Tools - Dev Containers - Docker - Pylance - Python - Python Debugger - GitHub Copilot - GitHub Copilot Chat ## Issue Description The VS Code main process shows extreme memory usage spikes (200%+ as shown in Process Explorer) that occur specifically when: 1. **Starting to type** a chat message in Copilot Chat 2. **During typing** (intermittently while composing messages) 3. **During response processing** by Copilot ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Open VS Code with a typical project workspace 2. Open Copilot Chat 3. Begin typing a message 4. Monitor memory usage via Process Explorer (`Cmd+Shift+P` → "Process Explorer") 5. Observe memory spikes in the main "code" process ## Expected Behavior Memory usage should increase moderately during AI processing but should not spike to 200%+ of normal usage, especially during simple text input. ## Actual Behavior Consistent memory spikes of 200%+ in the main VS Code process during chat interactions, particularly at the start of typing and during message composition. ## Additional Notes - Issue is isolated to Copilot Chat usage - Minimal extension setup rules out conflicts - Memory spikes are consistent and reproducible - Restarting VS Code temporarily resolves the issue until next chat usage ## Impact This excessive memory usage can cause system slowdowns and may force users to restart VS Code frequently when using Copilot Chat.
